tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Create a new lesgooo plan and get its shareable links. Optionally adds the user as the first participant (returns their participant_token). Only call after the user asked for it.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read a plan: today's date, title, event details, participants and their available dates and RSVP, the best dates so far (with weekday), the places being voted on (with place_id) and the currency for shared costs. Pass since (the server_time of an earlier call) to also get a list of what changed: peo

tools.name: join_plan
tools.description: Join a plan as the person you act for. If a participant with the same name already exists, you act as them (like picking your name in the app). Returns participant_id and participant_token. Confirm the name with the user first.

tools.name: set_availability
tools.description: Set which days the person is free (YYYY-MM-DD, today up to 2 years ahead). mode: "replace" (default) sets exactly these days, "add" / "remove" change them. Only with the user's confirmation.

tools.name: set_rsvp
tools.description: Answer whether the person is coming: "yes", "no", or "clear" to remove the answer. For a repeating event the answer is for one occurrence: the next one by default, or pass occurrence_date (see get_plan event.upcoming). Only with the user's confirmation.

tools.name: add_place
tools.description: Suggest a place the group can vote on (Where tab). Give a name and optionally an address plus either a Google Maps link or any other web link (Mapy.cz, Airbnb, Booking, the venue's website). Duplicates are merged. Acts as the participant.

tools.name: vote_place
tools.description: Up-vote ("up"), down-vote ("down") or remove your vote ("clear") on a place, by place_id from get_plan. Only with the user's confirmation.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: Read the plan's shared checklist: open and done items, with item_id.

tools.name: add_checklist_item
tools.description: Add an item to the plan's shared checklist (e.g. "Bring the grill"). Acts as the participant.

tools.name: check_item
tools.description: Mark a checklist item done (done: true) or open again (done: false), by item_id from get_checklist.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Change the shared event everyone sees on the RSVP page: title, date/time, place or description. Only after the group agreed. Times are local (no time zone); omit start_time for an all-day event. Send only the fields to change; an empty string clears a field.

tools.name: get_expenses
tools.description: Read the plan's shared costs (Splitwise tab): expenses, each person's balance, and the suggested payments to settle up. Amounts are in the plan's currency.

tools.name: add_expense
tools.description: Record a shared expense, split equally. paid_by defaults to the person you act for; split_among defaults to everyone in the plan. Always confirm the amount and who shares it with the user first.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record that the person you act for paid someone back (settling up). amount defaults to what they owe that person according to get_expenses. Only after the money was actually sent.

tools.name: remove_entry
tools.description: Delete an expense, payment, checklist item or place that the person you act for added (e.g. to fix a wrong amount: remove, then add again). Entries added by others can't be removed here. Always confirm with the user first.
